description.value: Good Thief is a 43-seat Vietnamese-inspired cocktail bar and restaurant on Main Street, positioned as the 'rebellious sibling' to Anh and Chi. It centres on nhậu—the Vietnamese tradition of communal eating, drinking, and banter—rendered through whimsical cocktails and inventive share plates such as pho-tine and wagyu beef tartare. The venue has a strong community ethos, having collectively raised over $500,000 for local nonprofits through its Reservation by Donation program.
